messages:
Marta P.: Heads up — after flipping the q2 quant canary on rwd-13b we started seeing structured-output drift for funcalling/tool invocation. Parse failure rate jumped from ~0.4% to ~3.2% in canary.

Raj K.: Do we have a diffed example vs baseline? could be tokenization around braces/commas.

Chen L.: Repro steps and raw output below.

Chen L.: ```json
PROMPT: { "task": "create_ticket", "fields": { "summary": "..." }}
MODEL_OUTPUT (truncated): {
  "action": "create_ticket",
  "params": { "summary": "Buy more GPUs", "priority": high, }
  "ticket_id": "12345"
}
``` 

Samir R.: Looks like missing quotes around "high" and a trailing comma. But note the model dropped an opening brace earlier in a few traces — smells like kv-cache/prefix truncation.

Marta P.: Yep — the failures correlate with batched requests where prefix length ~512 and the cached KV shard boundary lines up with the JSON start. If cache returns stale/partial context the generator emits malformed JSON.

Raj K.: Also seeing retry hysteresis: our current retry policy resubmits the same prompt -> same cache-hit -> same bad output. We need cache invalidation on retries or a small augmentation (set temperature=0, disable cache) for retry attempts.

Chen L.: Quick mitigation: post-parse repair heuristics (add quotes, close braces) plus a guarded retry with `--no-kv-cache` in the runtime. Will run A/B.

EvalBot: Canary stats: parse_fail_rate=0.032 (n=5600) baseline=0.004 (n=12000). Canary->baseline delta=+0.028, p<0.001. Rolling back for Dedicated until fix.

Marta P.: Plan: (1) disable KV cache for canary q-quantized models while we debug; (2) add cache-invalidating retry path; (3) run targeted eval on 1k toolcall prompts to verify. Anyone wanna own follow-up tickets?

Raj K.: I'll own (2) and the retry patch.

Chen L.: I'll run the 1k eval and assemble a diff set.

Samir R.: I'll prototype the repair-then-retry postprocessor.

Marta P.: Thanks team. Filing follow-ups in #incidents and linking here. :thumbsup:
